# Java Audiveris 5.11 (JDK 25, Temurin 25.0.3) GRID output on PDF sheets.
#
# The nine data/examples pages the other grid-*.txt oracles pin are all PNG or
# JPEG. The PDF path reproduces PDFBox's rendered raster exactly on all 189
# corpus pages, but that is a weaker claim than reproducing the recognition:
# adaptive binarization sits between them, and one flipped pixel has moved a
# staff line before. These sheets grade the rest of the chain.
#
# Sheets are chosen to span the render regimes rather than sampled: JBIG2 with
# and without shear, CCITT plain and with /Decode [1 0], the one Indexed
# three-band page, and a sheet from the source whose ten pages all take the
# nearest-neighbour ScaledBlit path instead of the bicubic transform.
#
# Four of the eleven are sheets Java refuses -- covers and title pages with no
# regularly spaced lines. That refusal is itself a parity fact and is recorded
# rather than skipped: the port has to fail on the same sheets, for the same
# reason.
#
# Sheet numbers count from one, as ImageLoading.Loader.getImage(int id) does.
# Grades are printed at full precision rather than the three decimals
# sheet#N.xml persists, because this reads the live SIG.
#
# Generated by oracle/java/GridPdfProbe.java; the corpus itself is not in the
# repository (see HANDOFF.md).
#
# page <file>#<sheet>
# failed <message>                       -- the sheet Java refuses
# staff <id> <left> <right> <line-count>
# barline <staff> <shape> <width> <grade> <ctx-grade> <frozen> <staff-end> <x1> <y1> <x2> <y2>
